TrueBase

ProductsPartnershipHow It WorksAbout UsContact

Become a Partner

About Us

Made for people who remember with love.

TrueBase began from a very personal place: the wish to keep the small, everyday moments with a pet from quietly disappearing. We believe love is not only remembered at the end. It is built through daily walks, waiting at the door, shared routines, and years of care.

View ProductsContact Us
Life the corgi
Our beginning

A company born from learning how pets become family

Joey, the founder of TrueBase, was not always a natural pet person. When he was young, he was even afraid of dogs. The change came slowly. About ten years ago, a close friend began raising a Bichon, and Joey often helped take care of it. Feeding, walking, waiting, cleaning, and simply being present changed the way he understood animals.

Later, Joey brought home his own corgi, Life, when Life was only three months old. Life is now about two and a half years old. Raising him made companionship feel less like an idea and more like a daily promise: to notice, to care, and to remember.

When his friend’s Bichon reached the last stage of life, Joey felt how quickly time gathers into memory. A pet can be beside us every day for years, and then suddenly every photo, paw print, collar, and small habit becomes precious. TrueBase was created from that feeling.

TrueBase exists to help pet owners turn ordinary days into lasting remembrance, while the love is still close and after the goodbye has come.
Life
What we want to do

Keep memory close, with dignity and warmth

TrueBase creates and sources pet memorial products for people who want to honor a real relationship, not just buy an object. We focus on keepsakes, urns, frames, memory boxes, jewelry, candles, garden markers, and customized remembrance products that can hold a name, a photo, a date, a paw print, or a story.

For families, we hope these products bring comfort. For clinics, stores, and memorial service partners, we hope they make it easier to offer thoughtful aftercare with sincerity, quality, and respect.

Our purpose

What TrueBase stands for

We make and source thoughtful pet memorial products for owners, clinics, stores, and professional partners who care about memory as much as merchandise.

Companionship

Pets grow with us. We build products that respect the bond between people and animals.

Memory

Photos, names, paw prints, collars, and everyday stories deserve a place to stay.

Care

Our work is quiet, practical, and sincere: helping families and partners handle remembrance with dignity.

Company information

Registered company details

Truebase Holding LLC is registered as a Wyoming Limited Liability Company. The information below is based on the company’s Wyoming Articles of Organization.

TrueBase

ProductsPartnershipHow It WorksContact

Become a Partner

Products

Premium Pet Memorial Product Catalog

Explore high-end memorial product lines selected around buyer demand on Amazon, Etsy, and specialty memorial retailers. Each category includes practical specification ranges for sourcing, private label planning, and sample development.

Request CatalogGet Samples / Quote
Category overview

Popular memorial categories, refined for premium B2B catalogs

Each product line is presented at category level, so buyers can compare formats, specifications, customization options, and sample planning without duplicate SKU blocks.

Best seller / Made to order

Signature Ceramic Pet Urns

Premium ceramic and stone-look urns for clinics, funeral homes, and boutique retail displays. A calm, home-decor-friendly tribute for families who want a refined memorial object.

View specifications

Private label ready

Wooden Memory & Keepsake Boxes

Luxury wood boxes designed for ashes, collars, fur clippings, photos, tags, and small memorial items. This category now covers tree-of-life and rainbow paw wooden memorial boxes inside one coherent wooden memorial line.

View specifications

Top memorial gift category

Ashes & Paw Print Jewelry

Wearable memorial keepsakes including ashes pendants, paw print jewelry, and delicate necklace charms for families who want a small remembrance close at hand.

View specifications

Clinic aftercare favorite

Memorial Photo Frames

Elegant tabletop frames and shadow-box style displays for photos, collars, paw prints, and small keepsakes. Built for compassionate clinic handoff programs.

View specifications

Premium upgrade

Glass Art Keepsakes

Decorative glass-inspired memorial pieces positioned as high-end upgrades for families seeking a display object rather than a traditional urn.

View specifications

Custom engraved

Engraved Memorial Sets

Coordinated sets that combine a keepsake box, mini urn, photo card, and personalized engraving for a polished, premium package experience.

View specifications

Outdoor memorial

Garden Stones & Grave Markers

Outdoor memorial markers for gardens, burial areas, and home landscapes, including compact resin photo memorial markers for pet loss gifts and aftercare catalogs.

View specifications

Sympathy add-on

Remembrance Candles & Gift Sets

Thoughtful sympathy products that pair well with urns, frames, and keepsake boxes. Useful for clinics and retailers building tiered memorial bundles.

View specifications

Product details

Category images, detail angles, and specification ranges

Wooden boxes, memorial jewelry, glass keepsakes, and garden markers include a lifestyle product image plus white-background detail images. The remaining categories retain their previous page structure.

TrueBase
Best seller / Made to order

Signature Ceramic Pet Urns

Premium ceramic and stone-look urns for clinics, funeral homes, and boutique retail displays. A calm, home-decor-friendly tribute for families who want a refined memorial object.

Product specifications

Capacity planning 1 cubic inch per 1 lb of pet weight; add 10-20% buffer.
Suggested sizes XS 15-25 cu in, S 40-60 cu in, M 80-110 cu in, L 150-200 cu in.
Exterior options ceramic cylinder, rounded keepsake jar, stone-look vessel, wood-lid vessel.
Customization engraved nameplate, paw icon, date line, quote, color glaze, gift box.
Recommended channels: Veterinary clinics, pet funeral services, boutique pet retail
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Private label ready

Wooden Memory & Keepsake Boxes

Luxury wood boxes designed for ashes, collars, fur clippings, photos, tags, and small memorial items. This category now covers tree-of-life and rainbow paw wooden memorial boxes inside one coherent wooden memorial line.

Product specifications

Included product formats Tree-of-life wooden urn box, rainbow paw wooden keepsake box, photo-frame wooden memorial box.
Known product sizes 13 x 13 x 18 cm; 14.5 x 14.5 x 19 cm; 25.5 x 18.5 x 19 cm.
Materials Wood, MDF/veneer options, resin decorative accents, optional velvet or linen insert.
Packaging references 18 pcs/carton at 46 x 43 x 48 cm; large format 8 pcs/carton at 62 x 47 x 48 cm.
Customization photo slot, laser engraving, nameplate, tree-of-life motif, rainbow paw motif, branded sleeve or kraft box.
Recommended channels: Aftercare bundles, gift retail, OEM programs
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Top memorial gift category

Ashes & Paw Print Jewelry

Wearable memorial keepsakes including ashes pendants, paw print jewelry, and delicate necklace charms for families who want a small remembrance close at hand.

Product specifications

Product formats Stainless steel ashes pendant necklace, heart pendant, paw print necklace, small memorial charm.
Material options 316L stainless steel, sterling silver option, plated accents, crystal or resin inlay.
Known references Pendant carton reference 13 x 8 x 9 cm, 150 g; custom sets can be packed as jewelry gift boxes.
Packaging Gift pouch, insert card, display card, jewelry box, branded retail tray.
Customization engraving, finish colors, birthstone detail, logo card, color hardware, retail display set.
Recommended channels: Premium upsell, online memorial gifts, clinic aftercare
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Clinic aftercare favorite

Memorial Photo Frames

Elegant tabletop frames and shadow-box style displays for photos, collars, paw prints, and small keepsakes. Built for compassionate clinic handoff programs.

Product specifications

Photo formats 4 x 6 in print slot, 10 x 10 in frame option, shadow-box format.
Shadow box reference about 10.75 x 8.75 x 1.25 in deep.
Collar support XS/S collar from 4 in minimum buckled length; MD/LG from 8.06 in minimum.
Display options tabletop easel, wall hanger, hinged back, glass or acrylic front.
Recommended channels: Veterinary clinics, funeral service providers, retail displays
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Premium upgrade

Glass Art Keepsakes

Decorative glass-inspired memorial pieces positioned as high-end upgrades for families seeking a display object rather than a traditional urn.

Product specifications

Orb sizes 2, 3, and 4 in options; art-glass references include 3.25, 4, and 5.5 in diameter.
Ash quantity typically a small pinch to 1/2 tsp depending on format.
Formats orb, heart, touchstone, pendant, desktop paperweight, optional light stand.
Customization 1-3 color blends, discreet ash placement, viewing window, short inscription upgrade.
Recommended channels: Premium memorial packages, online gifts, boutique retail
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Custom engraved

Engraved Memorial Sets

Coordinated sets that combine a keepsake box, mini urn, photo card, and personalized engraving for a polished, premium package experience.

Product specifications

Set structure keepsake box + mini urn + photo insert + sympathy card + optional candle or charm.
Box size range 15-32 cm square memory boxes or 30 x 20 x 13 cm dog memory box.
Engraving zone pet name, memorial years, short quote, paw icon, silhouette, partner logo.
Packaging kraft gift box, black rigid box, velvet pouch, branded insert, barcode-ready sleeve.
Recommended channels: Funeral service packages, OEM collections, sample kits
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Outdoor memorial

Garden Stones & Grave Markers

Outdoor memorial markers for gardens, burial areas, and home landscapes, including compact resin photo memorial markers for pet loss gifts and aftercare catalogs.

Product specifications

Included product formats Resin photo memorial marker, resin stone-look marker, slate/granite-look plaque, river-stone marker.
Known compact marker size 11.5 x 7 x 11 cm, 320 g; package size 14.8 x 10.8 x 15.8 cm.
Functional details Inner space 4.5 x 3.5 x 10 cm; photo size 2.5 x 3.5 cm.
Carton reference 36 pcs/carton, 46.5 x 45.5 x 49.5 cm, 12 kg.
Customization name, memorial years, paw print, portrait engraving, indoor/outdoor finish.
Recommended channels: Garden retail, burial services, home memorial gifts
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales
TrueBase
Sympathy add-on

Remembrance Candles & Gift Sets

Thoughtful sympathy products that pair well with urns, frames, and keepsake boxes. Useful for clinics and retailers building tiered memorial bundles.

Product specifications

Popular candle size 9 oz glass jar, about 3.5 in high x 2.8 in diameter.
Alternative sizes 4 oz mini jar, 7 oz photo candle, 9 cm x 7 cm memorial candle.
Wax options soy wax, coconut-apricot wax, unscented or fragrance selections.
Customization pet photo, name, dates, quote, paw label, sympathy card, gift-ready box.
Recommended channels: Clinic condolences, gift bundles, retail add-ons
Request specs / samplesTalk to sales

Images and copy are prepared for wholesale, OEM, and private-label buyer review, with SEO-friendly category names and product schema.

TrueBase can support product selection, engraving direction, packaging systems, sample kits, and private-label presentation for professional memorial product buyers.
